riders.note: Your eyes are closed. You are blinded, and a stack arrives at the end of each of your turns.

description.value:
Shaka fights with his eyes closed and opens them only when he intends to end things.

You close your eyes. Using this action applies @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Effect: Om], which is what blinds you and what holds the count.

While they are closed you are blinded — fully, with all that entails — but you gain one Om stack at the end of each of your turns, to a maximum of 5 (7 on a day Virgo is ascendant).

While you have at least 1 stack you gain a +1 status bonus per stack to your Technique DCs and to unarmed Strike damage. From 7th level your Sixth Sense functions as a precise sense out to 30 feet, letting you fight blind.

The cost is real and the sheet enforces it — the class guide is explicit that the table should not wave it away.

To spend the stacks, use @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Open Your Eyes].
